batting.name: B Sai Sudharsan
batting.dismissal: c R Parag b M Theekshana

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c R Parag b M Theekshana

batting.name: Washington Sundar
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b Sandeep Sharma

balls.text: low full toss, driven to wide long on and they sprint back for the second to give Buttler his half-century off 26 balls ... GT finish with a whopping 209 on a pitch that wasn't supposed to be a 200 pitch
fast one in the blockhole outside off, Buttler tries to smash it through the off side but misses, terrific ball
pulled to deep midwicket for a single to give Buttler the strike after 10 balls
full and wide outside off, SRK reaches for it and slashes the ball in the air and into the gap on the deep point boundary

given lbw but Tewatia reviews immediately. Archer went full and at the stumps, Tewatia moved right across his crease to try and flick behind square leg but missed, ball tracking says that would have hit leg stump so he's got to go
high full toss and Tewatia launches it over the deep backward point boundary by opening the face and letting the ball ping off his bat, used the pace superbly
pulled to deep square leg for a single to keep the strike
gets a short ball first up, pulls it towards cow corner for two more

this time Hetmyer catches it and it's a superb grab! Washington sliced the ball high into the air just beyond the circle at mid-off. Hetmyer came sprinting in from deep cover, while Yudhvir was running back from cover, Hetmyer dived full length and caught it and Yudhvir managed to avoid crashing into him
tries to play the reverse slog sweep but loses balance and falls over, the ball whizzes past off stump
wide outside off again, driven from the crease towards deep cover where Hetmyer fields but can't prevent the second
short and wide outside off stump, so many wides in the last couple of overs
width outside off and Washington hits it hard off the back foot towards deep cover, Hetmyer tag-teams with Hasaranga to save the boundary
sprayed wide outside off from over the wicket to the left-hander, Washington lets it pass
delicate this time from Buttler, gets down low and reverse-chips Archer, using his pace to launch the ball flat over short third's head
driven to long on for a single, Archer went full and straight that time
pulled over fine leg! Sublime from Sundar. He gets inside the line to a short of a length ball and just helps it on its way, using the pace of the bowler
short of a length with width outside off from around the wicket, Buttler slaps it through extra cover
stays around the wicket to the right-hander and slants a full ball across Buttler, who just clears his front foot towards the leg side and slams the ball high and far over the long-on boundary
full toss from around the wicket to the left-hander around off stump, pushed past point from the crease for a single
full and in the blockhole wide outside off, Buttler reaches for it and digs it out into the off side
driven on the front foot to long off

full toss and Gill hits it straight to Parag on the long-off boundary! Sometimes when he plays that checked-lofted shot you wonder if he would be better served by giving it a full swing of the arms instead to get more elevation and distance. Gill goes off 84 off 50 balls with GT on course for 200
backs away outside leg to hit a full ball through covers, opened the face to slice that
finally the line is straight, the length nearly in the blockhole, Gill digs it out to long on
goes full and wide once again, Gill lets it go again, third wide of the over
short of a length with width outside off, Gill lofts the ball flat over extra cover and into the gap on the boundary
fired it full outside off but once again it's too wide and Gill lets it go
too wide outside off, Gill lets it go
bottom edges the cut off the short of a length ball into the ground
oh wow, that's a pretty good length ball outside off, Buttler simply reverse swats it over the head of the fielder at short third
gets down low and really reaches for a wide delivery outside off and then plays a top-spin type shot back at the bowler, Sandeep fields in his follow through
Sandeep sees the batter coming at him and so bowls a wide one outside off, too wide though
wide outside off, Buttler reaches for it and cuts to deep point
slow bouncer outside off, Gill gets on top of the bounce, waits for it, and slaps it down towards deep third
short of a length outside off, cut to deep point
full outside off, Buttler tries to go big down the ground but ends up slicing it over cover instead, 24 runs off that over and GT are on the charge now
more punishment for Hasaranga as he drags the ball way too short, Buttler goes back and pulls the ball over deep midwicket
short ball down leg side, Buttler swivels and drags the pull wide of short fine leg and fine of deep square leg
straight this time! Buttler steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball, and hits it so clean over the bowler's head
he's connected with this slog sweep all right, clearing his front foot and slamming it over deep square
wide down leg side, too far for Buttler to connect with the slog sweep
Buttler tries to slam the ball through midwicket but gets a bottom edge to short fine leg, Gill wants the strike and sets off but Buttler says no, that went straight to the fielder
Gill is in the mood all right, this time he spots the slower ball, waits for it by moving a bit across his crease and pulls the short of a length delivery high over the square leg boundary
slower ball, short of a length outside off, Gill tries to cut off the back foot and misses, beaten by the change of pace
whipped off the pads towards wide long on where Parag runs to his right and dives to save the boundary, that was hit from the blockhole almost
that's in the first tier! Too full and too straight, Gill launches it high and far with a powerful whip off the pads

Gill steps towards the off side just a little and Yudhvir responds by going wider outside off, Gill lets it go and then is surprised when the umpire does not call it a wide. He wants the review. A bit of the ball is inside the guideline so it remains a fair delivery
steps out and launches the ball towards deep midwicket, the bat face closed as he made contact and he did not time that perfectly
played through midwicket to finish a tidy over
steps out to attack but then changes plan and defends to the bowler
played through midwicket

what's happened there? Gill missed the slog sweep and fell over, the ball lobbed close to the pitch in front of the wicket near the silly point region, the keeper tried to reach it to take the catch but couldn't get to it. Not sure if there was bat on it
driven off the front foot to long on
hit hard off the back foot and Hasaranga does well to stop it with his right hand
short of a length ball gets a bit big on Buttler who swivels and pulls to the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary
shortens his length and pitches outside off, Gill plays the square drive to deep point
oh my, that's such a hit-me full toss, nice height on the pads, Gill lofts it clean over the deep midwicket boundary
pushed off the back foot gently towards long off, it's gone a bit quiet in the last couple of overs
width outside off again, Gill slaps the short of a length ball through cover point
skiddy ball on a good length outside off stump, Gill tries to cut off the back foot and misses
Gill moves forward and flicks the ball through midwicket
Buttler nudges the ball past the diving bowler towards mid off for a single
nudged off the front foot gently through midwicket, there's a gap in the in-field there so Gill wants two but Buttler says no
waits on the back foot and drives to long off to get going

caught at long on! Theekshana bowled the ball full from around the wicket and angled it into the left-hander, Sudharsan tried to clear the long-on boundary but couldn't, simple catch to Parag in the deep and the end of another rock solid opening partnership for GT
nudged off the pads through square leg for a single
this time he connects with the cut, hitting it to the fielder at deep point
tossed up slow and wide outside off, Gill goes back and tries to reach for it with the cut shot but misses
low full toss, slog swept along the ground to cow corner
wider line outside off, Gill goes back and cuts through cover point to bring up 50 off 29 balls, fourth of the season for him
full ball on middle and leg, he hits it along the ground through midwicket
leans forward and towards the off before closing the face to push a legbreak through midwicket
first six for Sai Sudharsan tonight, he rocks back to a short of a length ball and slams the pull over deep midwicket
make that 12 as Sai Sudharsan charges and slashes at a short of a length ball and misses, he was cramped for room there
in the blockhole outside off stump, angling across the left-hander, he jams his bat down and opens the face to steer past short third but misses ... just the 11th dot ball of the innings
short of a length and straight, Gill presses forward and pushes the ball through midwicket
full and on the pads again, Gill leans across and flicks in front of square this time
strays on to the pads with a full ball that Gill leans across and glances to the fine leg boundary, cannot bowl that line with fine leg in the circle
pulled off the back foot to wide long on where Parag moves quickly to his left and dives, he relays the throw to Theekshana who sends it back towards the pitch
worked through midwicket for one more
hit hard off the back foot to cover where a misfield allows the single
gets down on one knee and plays a slog sweep towards deep backward square where Jaiswal dives and saves the boundary
short ball, Sai Sudharsan goes back and pulls along the ground to deep midwicket
nudged off the back foot through square leg
a full toss driven to long on for a single
played safely through square leg this time for a single
dropped again or just short? Gill plays a half-hearted semi-pull, chipping the ball in the air towards deep square, the 14-year old Suryavanshi ran in and dived but could not quite get there
first six of the innings! Gill gets down on one knee and launches the ball over deep midwicket with a slog sweep
steps forward and across to whip the ball from outside off to deep midwicket
nudged off the pads through the leg side to take back the Orange Cap from Virat Kohli
a full toss on the pads from around the wicket and Sai Sudharsan misses the flick and gets hit on the pads, Sandeep appeals for lbw but that's missing leg stump easily
steps out and manages to hit the drive cleanly to long on even though he's a bit cramped for room by the good length delivery
strays down leg side with an attempted yorker
steps out to take the ball on the full and flicks it off the pads to deep wicket where Hetmyer dives to make the save, that's another 50 partnership for this pair this season
fuller length outside off, driven firmly just wide of mid-off and they run a quick single
another push off the pads to the man at midwicket
worked off the pads to the fielder at midwicket
fired in quick from around the wicket, worked off the pads towards wide long on, the fielder runs around from deep midwicket to pick it up
a full toss, quite a high one that too, Gill was on the front foot and ends up swatting it to wide long on
tries to force it through midwicket and gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg
played in front of square leg for two more, hit it just wide enough to give them enough time to come back for the second
this time he pierces the gap between mid-on and midwicket, and just with a wristy flick off the back foot, outstanding timing
dropped short and he's lucky to get away with that one, Sai Sudharsan pulled the ball along the ground but could not beat the fielder at midwicket
presses forward and cuts along the ground towards deep point
Archer keeps it on a length and straight, Sai Sudarshan moves across his stumps and whips it off middle in front of square for another boundary
played with softer hands towards cover point for a single
too full and too easy for Shubman Gill, who meets the ball on the front foot and hammers it past the bowler with a straight drive
good length angling across the left-hander, the batter whips the ball from outside off towards mid on
jumps on to the back foot and opens the face to steer to point
a forehand pull off the front foot and Gill hits it flat over the head of the fielder leaping in vain at mid on
this time Gill doesn't bother with keeping the short-arm pull on the ground, he goes over midwicket and makes great contact, too short from Yudhvir at his gentle pace
another short-arm pull off the front foot, this time to the fielder at short fine leg
short of a length around off stump, Gill meets it on the front foot and hits the short-arm pull straight to midwicket
short of a length angling across the left-hander, he stays on the back foot and cuts towards deep third
Gill pushes to mid on and calls his partner through for a quick single
played to mid off for a single

dropped by Hetmyer, that's a sitter! Sai Sudharsan hit that flat and firmly straight to him and Hetmyer dropped it at chest height, seemed to lose sight of the ball as he went for it with fingers pointing upwards
too full to the left-hander from around the wicket and Sai Sudharsan thumps it through covers with a front-foot drive
worked off the pads to deep midwicket once again
whipped off the pads firmly through midwicket, forcing a dive from the fielder on the boundary
Gill leans into the drive and places the ball through extra cover, he didn't hit that with much power

ends a superb over so far with a loose ball on the pads, too easy for Sai Sudharsan, who dispatches it to the square leg boundary with a flick off the pads all along the ground, Archer is upset with himself
no room to work with whatsoever, wicket to wicket on a good length, Sai Sudharsan stays in his crease and plays it back to the bowler
141 kph on a wicket to wicket line, Sai Sudharsan stays on the back foot and defends on the off side
wicket to wicket line on a good length, Gill moves back and across and pushes the ball towards mid on for a single
length delivery just outside off to the right-hander, Gill stays in his crease and dabs on the off side

just 138.5 kph to begin from Archer, length delivery angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Sai Sudharsan drives away from his body on the front foot and gets an outside edge to deep third
it's all over, a target of 210 chased down with 25 balls to spare, Parag finishes it by slamming the pull over deep midwicket, GT look stunned by what's happened in Jaipur tonight
played to long off for one more
goes right back and cuts the ball hard to the backward point boundary, he's played a superb innings too tonight, and on most days would be the player of the match for this performance

Siraj drops a high catch on the edge of the deep midwicket boundary! Parag went back and pulled the ball extremely high into the air, Siraj had to run to his right to get to the ball, he made good ground but could not hold on
pulled through square leg for a single, just 10 needed now
he's connected with it this time, slog-sweeping the ball flat and powerfully enough to beat deep backward square leg
gets beaten by the turn across him and misses the slog sweep
backs away outside leg stump and slaps the ball flat over the infield at cover
short ball from around the wicket and Parag sends it miles into the air and far over the midwicket boundary with a tremendous pull shot
nudged off the pads towards mid on
makes room by moving outside leg and gets a thick outside edge that flies over the fielder at backward point, Parag was aiming over cover point but gets four anyway
full and straight, flocked off the pads between midwicket and mid on
sort of a length angling across the left-hander, Jaiswal heaves at it and launches the ball over cover for three, not often you see that in the IPL
nudged towards long on for a single
played back to the bowler from the crease, Prasidh fumbles in the follow through but they decide against the single
short ball and pulled in the air but short of the fielder at deep midwicket
played with an open face to deep backward point
defended on the front foot on the leg side, Buttler appeals for lbw but doesn't get it, that might have pitched outside leg
flicked uppishly just wide of the fielder at midwicket
driven off the front foot through covers, placed it into the gap to come back for two
lbw! Rana brings out the reverse sweep and gets pinged on the front shoe by a full toss, the umpire raises the finger right away and Rana immediately asks for the review. Three reds, that's plumb
worked off the pads behind square leg for a single
defended on the back foot on the off side
too full outside off and Rana drills it to the cover boundary with a powerful cover drive

It's over, but what a time he's given all of us tonight. Prasidh ends the hundred with a yorker that crashes into the stumps after Suryavanshi misses it. Jaiswal goes up to him and hugs him, the incoming batter Nitish Rana hugs him, so many GT players go up to him and congratulate him. This is one of the most incredible innings the IPL has ever seen in its 18 years, and it's been played by a 14 year old.
full toss outside off, driven hard but to the fielder at cover
misses the pull this time and gets hit on the body by a short of a length ball
short of a length and Jaiswal dispatches it into the deep midwicket stands with a powerful pull, RR are mowing this down at breakneck speed
full ball from around the wicket, square driven behind point to bring up a 31-ball half-century
cut off the back foot to deep point
played to wide long on for two more
played to long on for a single

second fastest century in the IPL, he's got Rahul Dravid off his wheelchair! He gets there by pulling the legendary Rashid Khan over the midwicket boundary, goosebumps as he takes off his helmet and acknowledges this once in a lifetime moment. Everyone on their feet in Jaipur, Jaiswal gives him a hug ... but such is the pace of T20 cricket that the next ball has to be bowled quickly!
played towards point for a single, not sure he intended it to go there, off the edge
what on earth is going on in Jaipur, a slower one on a length and Suryavanshi hammers it over deep midwicket to take 30 runs off the over, what a welcome for Karim Janat
another full toss, another 100% shot and another boundary, driven hard and wide of long off for four more
short ball outside off, slashes and edges over the leaping Buttler for four more ... he's giving every shot everything, as hard as he can, and the edges are paying off too
full toss and smashed, swatted off his pads over deep square leg, on course for an incredible hundred here ... stuff off dreams unfolding in Jaipur
good length on middle, slightly slower too, he tries to smash that into oblivion on the leg side but gets an outside edge that flies over deep point
fetch that from the stands beyond square leg, welcome to the IPL Karim Janat! Too full on the pads and Suryavanshi flicks with power. GT are worried, very worried
looks to defend on the back foot on the off side but gets an inside edge towards leg
tries to work the ball off the pads but misses, appeal for lbw but that was pitching outside leg
gets down on one knee and lofts the ball behind square leg
take evasive action Rashid Khan! That was fuller and Suryavanshi drove hit hard and flat and straight just past the bowler
pinned on the back foot again by Rashid, who is keeping the ball flat and skiddy
hit off the back foot to long off

oh my goodness, stand and deliver stuff from Suryavanshi, clears his front foot towards the leg side and launches a length ball clean over long-off, this is some unreal hitting on show tonight, shot of the innings for me
nudged off the pads through square leg and they sprint the single but decide against the second
outside off with the line this time, cut off the back foot to deep backward point, RR are already past 100!
short of a length and down leg this time, Jaiswal gets inside the line and swivels to pull the ball past the keeper for four more
banged in short, the bouncer at Jaiswal's head, he bends his knees and uses his bat as a ramp to launch the ball high over the keeper's head
good length outside off from around the wicket, beats Jaiswal's cut shot on the back foot
gets hit on the back leg by a skiddy delivery after missing the whip off the back foot, but that too pitched outside leg, Rashid restores some normalcy to the innings with a four-run over
played to deep midwicket for a single
gets down on one knee and slogs the ball over square leg, does not time it well, he's just going for everything even against Rashid
goes back and works the ball off the pads through square leg
steps out and slogs towards the leg side, misses and gets hit on the thigh again for a leg bye

huge appeal for lbw first ball, umpire says not out after Suryavanshi misses the hoick towards leg and gets hit on the pad. GT are asking for a review. He was hit on the back thigh, with his knee bent. No inside edge but ball tracking shows the ball pitching outside leg, so it stays not out
punched off the back foot into the off side, RR have knocked 87 runs off their target inside the powerplay, as far as starts go, this is near perfect
worked off the pads behind square, uses the angle into him from around the wicket to help it along to the fine leg boundary
deft this time, stays back in his crease and opens the face to steer to deep third, where the fielder is placed quite fine
charges down the pitch and slogs a bit wildly, gets beaten by the bouncer
Suryavanshi aims to slog down the ground but the length is too short and the ball zips past him from around the wicket
short of a length outside off, slashed down to third man, giving Siraj work to do

a half-century off 17 balls for the 14-year old Suryavanshi, the fastest fifty of the season. What are we witnessing tonight? He gets there by playing a lofted drive over cover. RR are going at 16 an over the the powerplay.
another one, this time over long leg, Sundar pitches too short and strays down leg, Suryavanshi uses the angle and just hammers it
mis-times a slog over the leg side to square leg

too short from Sundar from around the wicket to the left-hander, Suryavanshi rocks back and pulls the ball over the deep square leg boundary, he's hitting the ball into the stands. This is breathtaking to watch
played down to long on for a single
the runs keep coming for RR, Jaiswal backs away and slaps the ball through the covers

and again! A one-bounce four this time to deep third. Suryavanshi aims for the leg side with a mighty swing, Ishant keeps the ball wide outside off and it pings of the thick edge of his bat ... 28 runs off that over, Ishant's most expensive in IPL history
another wide outside off, Ishant shortened his length but the line too extreme ...he's trying to stay away from the batter's swinging arc
sprays it extremely wide outside off stump from over the wicket
this kid is giving it everything tonight, swings his bat so hard that the outside edge carries all the way over the third man boundary, he was aiming to send that length ball over the leg side
short of a length slanting across the left-hander outside off, tries to cut and misses

in the air and just over the fielder Siraj running back from mid off. Suryavanshi came down the pitch and was met with a short of a length delivery, he checked his shot but checked it well enough to clear the fielder and run to the boundary
Ishant Sharma has been smashed into the first tier beyond the midwicket boundary! Tremendous hitting. The ball was too full this time and he just launched it miles with a wristy flick
how about that from the 14-year old! Moves back and across to a short ball and hooks it over the square leg boundary
too full on the pads from Siraj and Jaiswal flicks it powerfully into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary
full ball on the pads, Jaiswal tries to swings it away to long leg but misses and gets hit on the pad, Buttler moves to his right and dives to save the boundary
Siraj goes fuller with his length outside off and Jaiswal smashes it flat and hard over the head of the fielder at mid off
has that gone all the way? No, just bounced inside the long-on boundary. Siraj banged it in short and Jaiswal responded with a flat-batted pull off the back foot
short of a length at the body, Suryavanshi swivels and pulls the ball towards deep square leg, did not time that well
tries to push a short of a length ball angling across him from over the wicket on the off side but gets an inside edge on to his pads
how far has that gone? Length ball on a wicket to wicket line, Jaiswal clears his front leg and simply slams it, hitting the ball on the the roof of a structure beyond the wide long-on boundary
Jaiswal backs away to try and bash a good length ball through cover but can't pierce the infield
good length and straight, Jaiswal defends from his crease
good length outside off, lets it go
played into the off side for a single

dropped by Buttler! I'm not sure that was his catch. Jaiswal tried to pull but skied the ball high in the air off the top edge, it flew miles in the air towards point, Buttler called for it and covered a lot of ground to get to the ball well in time but them dropped it as it swirled away from him. The fielder at point would have had much less ground to make to reach that catch. Buttler covered 21 metres to get there
Siraj bounces the 14-year old, Suryavanshi tries to upper cut but misses
short and wide outside off, Jaiswal frees his arms and cuts hard to deep point
punched off the back foot to mid off where a fumble allows the single, that was in the air and Prasidh tried to reach it with the slide but couldn't stop it cleanly
massive hit down the ground, just pressed forward and swung through the line to smash the length ball high and far over the straight boundary
short of a length and much straighter, with serious bounce, squares up the batter and beats him with the zip across the left-hander
sprays it far outside off this time, Suryavanshi tries to reach it but it's too wide
short of a length down leg side, too far away for Suryavanshi to make contact with the glance
short of a length slanting across the left-hander, Jaiswal stays back and cuts hard to deep third
